args.text:
Crew brain (v1)

1. Play only on certainty: before any play, check viewTowers for the tower's next rank. Never play a guessed card. A misfire costs a strike; three strikes end the game.
2. Signals name a playable card: give a suit or rank signal only when the named card is the next rank of its tower, so the receiver can play it at once. Expect the receiver to play it.
3. Signals are scarce (6 max). Spend one when it unlocks a play; do not spend on cards that cannot be played yet.
4. When the crew has 6 signals or a slot is dead (rank already lit, or below its tower, or its gap is lost), discard that slot to earn a signal back.
5. Lower ranks first: play or hold cards so each tower advances in order. Keep 5s and higher until lower ranks of their suit are lit.
6. Read teammates' visible cards before acting; they are the best information we have.
